references.title: Continuous variable quantum advantages and applications in quantum optics
Quantum State Estimation, edited by M. Paris and J. Rehacek
High amplitude cat states are ‘more non-Gaussian’ than low amplitude cat states
The main difference between low amplitude cat + and cat − states is that the former are easier to approximate by low stellar rank states than the latter
The maximum achievable fidelity increases more from odd to even ranks (resp. even to odd ranks) than from even to odd ranks (resp. odd to even ranks) for cat + states (resp. cat − states)
